days.title: Waterways and Central Lowlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mittellandkanal
stops.detail: Today, the lowland with the Mittelland Canal and the rivers Aller and Ohre is a retreat for rare or endangered animal and plant species.

stops.name: Aller
stops.detail: The Ohre, flowing through the lowlands and emptying into the Elbe, drains to the east, while the Aller touches the lowlands and drains toward the Weser.

days.title: Moors and Forest Reserves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Forsthaus Giebel
stops.detail: The protected Kleine and Große Giebelmoor near the Giebel forest house (Samtgemeinde Brome in Lower Saxony) is known for a natural forest reserve with alder and birch swamp forest.

stops.name: Jeggauer Moor
stops.detail: Typical representatives, especially in the Jeggauer Moor nature reserve, are the pillwort (Pilularia globulifera) and the floating club-rush (Eleogiton fluitans), which belong to the trench vegetation.
